description:
Log into Oscar EMR (username: oscardoc, password: oscar, PIN: 1117) and add two Past Medical History (PMHx) entries to patient Maria Santos's Cumulative Patient Profile (CPP) in the eChart.

Patient: Maria Santos (DOB: 1985-07-22)

Add the following two items to the Medical History (PMHx) section of her CPP:
1. Cholecystectomy 2018
2. Pneumonia hospitalization 2020

IMPORTANT: Add these to the 'Medical History' or 'PMHx' section of the CPP specifically (not 'Ongoing Concerns', 'Social History', or other sections). Save the entries so they persist.

Oscar EMR is available at http://localhost:8080/oscar/login.jsp in the open Firefox browser.
